messages:
Aisha: ran a focused perf pass on host proxy + tokenizer changes. p95 for short requests crept up ~9% when tokenization overlapped with many tiny gRPC writes. uploading a small flame.

infra-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1768601234/trace.tgz

Tom: quick summary?

Aisha: hotspots are tokenizer::iter_bytes, proxy::writev (lots of <512B writes), and memcpy in parse->slab. Syscalls (sendmsg) show up often. KV-cache had brief eviction spikes on cross-shard access. No big mutex waits.

Diego: likely two problems: small-write amplification at proxy + allocator churn in tokenize path. Also kernel selector favors kernel_x for seq<64 which reduces GPU time but forces extra host formatting; cost model was tuned on longer sequences.

Elaine: batching note: many requests are effectively batch=1 end-to-end; host overhead won't amortize. Consider adaptive batching or a tiny write coalescer.

Aisha: propose canary matrix: (1) proxy writev coalesce (threshold 256B || 3ms), (2) tokenizer fixed buffer pool (recycle 64KB buffers), (3) tweak kernel cost to penalize host_syscall for short sequences, (4) emit kvcache shard telemetry.

Tom: measure p50/p95/p99, cpu-s/sec/request, syscall_count, small_write_ratio. Add dashboard panel for small_write_ratio.

Diego: will prototype kernel tweak behind flag: cost = host_parse_ms + kernel_ms + syscall_count*0.08ms and bias for seq<64.

Elaine: I can add dashboards and a rollback gate: rollback if p99 > 2% or cpu_sec/request > 10%.

Aisha: owners: I own rollout and baselines, Tom owns proxy changes, Diego owns kernel prototype, Elaine dashboards. Starting canary in ~40m.

infra-bot: created ticket PERF-3192: "host proxy small-write coalesce + tokenizer pool canary" and canary job redwood/canaries/host-opt-1768601234."
